# Sample series fixture

This folder is test data. It is not a series workspace and not a film.

The tool repository holds the studio and this fixture only. A real series is a directory outside the repository, created with `init-series`, and it may be its own git repository.

`ep01` is a short fictional episode so CI can run brief approval, both language packs, pace, claim precision, doctor, and a silent draft preview. The approval fields and checklist names are fixture data. Do not copy them into a production episode.
